the role of dietary factors on the glucose tolerance of aging.
the role of dietary factors on glucose tolerance, and in particular on the insulin sensitivity index.
the role of diet in the pathogenesis of the glucose intolerance of normal aging, and the role of insulin in the regulation of glucose homeostasis in the elderly.

the glucose tolerance of aging is associated with insulin sensitivity and beta-cell dysfunction that is improved by a very high carbohydrate intake.

aging is associated with a decrease in glucose tolerance, which is due to a decrease in insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function.
